target.name: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund V, Inc.

acquirer.name: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund VI, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund V, Inc. (NYSE:HYV) and BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund VI, Inc. (NYSE:HYT)

announcement.quote: have approved the reorganization of each of BHY, COY, CYE, HIS and HYV into HYT, with HYT continuing as the surviving fund (each, a “Reorganization”).

outcome_evidence.quote: The Fund was a party to a senior committed secured, 360-day rolling credit facility (the “Credit Facility”), which was terminated as of the effective date of the Merger.

deals.notes: Shareholders of all funds approved on October 11, 2013 (press release of 2013-10-15, accession 0001341004-13-001059, expected effectiveness November 18, 2013). The N-8F filed by HYV (reason: Merger, shareholder vote October 11, 2013, all assets distributed) is the only completion evidence in the excerpts; it does not give the closing date in the excerpt.
